remaining_concerns: The admissible record still does not show that the final model-card or certification text actually contains the required disclosure, so present-tense implementation compliance is not evidenced.

The small-business support slice's materiality is not independently established beyond threshold underperformance plus policy language about protected or contractual segments; that point should remain carefully qualified.

Any action label or recommendation that reads as unconditional certification would still overstate the admissible support because no approved mitigation is in evidence and disclosure is the only potentially compliant path.
final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor materially narrowed the position using the same admissible evidence, not because any new evidence was added. On this narrowed reading, the supportable claim is not unconditional certification, but a policy-bounded position: aggregate performance supports overall readiness (BMCARD-008-A), the small-business support slice underperforms (BMCARD-008-B), no approved mitigation exists (BMCARD-008-E), and sampling uncertainty supports follow-up caution rather than resolution (BMCARD-008-D). Under the policy text and BMCARD-008-C, that makes disclosure the only potentially compliant path. That is enough for compliant_with_caveats as an audit of the narrowed recommendation. It is not enough for full compliance because the record still lacks evidence that the required disclosure has actually been made, and the materiality predicate remains only partially established on the current record.
